Display Bonding cell

±3µm

layer alignment

Automated optical clear adhesive (OCA) lamination

Foldable & Flexible Display Bonding

Bubble-free OCA lamination for OLED, LTPO and ultra-thin-glass foldable stacks. Closed-loop pressure and vacuum control eliminates crease deformation while vision-guided alignment keeps every layer within microns across 200,000+ fold cycles.

  • Vacuum-assisted roller lamination for UTG, CPI and polarizer layers
  • Real-time bubble & particle detection with automatic rework routing
  • Hinge-region stress mapping for inward and outward fold geometries
  • Compatible with 6.1" to 8.3" panels and tri-fold form factors
Alignment accuracy
±3 µm (3σ)
Lamination pressure
0.05 – 0.6 MPa, closed-loop
Vacuum level

  • Direct handoff to hinge sub-assembly cell via SECS/GEM
  • MES traceability at panel serial level
  • Class 100 mini-environment option

Innovation · Assembly Line Pipeline

From bare die to boxed device in five orchestrated stages.

Every stage shares one digital twin. Inspection data flows upstream in milliseconds, so the line corrects itself before defects propagate. Step through the pipeline to see what happens at each cell.

Stage 01 of 05

Wafer / Chip Placement

Bare die, SiP modules and 01005 passives are placed onto warpage-compensated substrates. Vision fiducials and neural offset correction bring every component within one micron of nominal before the board moves on.

  • Inline check3D solder-paste inspection before placement
  • Inline checkReel & feeder verification
  • Inline checkPlacement offset feedback loop
